description: Source file for the SearchForm2 class in SuiteCRM, which handles rendering search forms, managing search parameters, and generating search WHERE clauses for the application's list views.

classes.name: SearchForm
classes.description: Handles creation, rendering, and management of search forms within SuiteCRM, including setting search parameters, rendering tabs, and constructing WHERE clauses for searches.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new SearchForm instance with seed bean, module, action, options, and sets up default tabs.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up search definitions, fields, display view, list view definitions, and initializes tabs based on configuration flags.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the search form as HTML, including tabs, fields, and saved search options.

methods.name: getViewTab
methods.description: Determines the current view tab ('basic' or 'advanced') based on display view.

methods.name: getSearchInfo
methods.description: Collects and returns all user-defined search parameters as an associative array.

methods.name: findFieldOptionValue
methods.description: Searches within fields options to find the display value associated with a given key.

methods.name: getSearchInfoJson
methods.description: Returns the JSON-encoded string of the current search parameters.

methods.name: getColumnsFilterData
methods.description: Retrieves the last saved column filter data from the saved search.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Sets configuration options for the SearchForm instance.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns the current options for the SearchForm.

methods.name: locateFile
methods.description: Finds a template file in predefined search paths, prioritizing custom directories.

methods.name: displaySavedSearch
methods.description: Generates HTML for the saved search form, prepopulated with current ordering.

methods.name: displaySavedSearchSelect
methods.description: Creates HTML for the saved search selection dropdown.

methods.name: _displayTabs
methods.description: Builds HTML/JavaScript for rendering and managing UI tabs for different search modes.

methods.name: _build_field_defs
methods.description: Builds the field definitions for the search form based on configuration and seed object.

methods.name: populateFromArray
methods.description: Populates search fields from an associative array, such as request parameters or saved configurations.

methods.name: populateFromRequest
methods.description: Populates search fields directly from the $_REQUEST superglobal.

methods.name: parseDateExpression
methods.description: Translates a date expression operator into a SQL WHERE clause fragment.

methods.name: generateSearchWhere
methods.description: Main function that constructs the SQL WHERE clause based on current search parameters, handling various field types and operators.
